a: David Martyn Lloyd-Jones (1899–1981), eyamanyibwanga nga "the Doctor" (Omusawo), yali musawo muto wa magezi mu London — omuyambi w'omusawo wa Kabaka, Sir Thomas Horder — eyaleka obusawo n'agenda mu buweereza, ng'akkirizza nti endwadde y'omuntu esinga obuziba ya mwoyo. Oluvannyuma lw'emyaka kkumi n'egumu ng'alunda abakozi e Sandfields mu South Wales ey'amakolero, yabuulira mu ngeri ey'okunnyonnyola mu Westminster Chapel, London, okumala emyaka amakumi asatu era n'afuuka omuntu wa maanyi mu kuzzibwawo kw'okubuulira kwa Reformed mu kyasa eky'amakumi abiri.

Yazaalibwa mu Cardiff mu 1899 era n'akulira mu Cardiganshire omwogerwa Oluwelesi, n'oluvannyuma n'asengukira ne ab'omu maka ge e London, n'atendekebwa mu St Bartholomew's Hospital, erimu ku malwaliro g'e Britain ag'ettutumu. Ebyafaayo by'emyaka egyo bya busobozi obutakoowa: ebisaanyizo n'ekitiibwa ekya waggulu, ddigrii ya MD mu 1923 olw'okunoonyereza ku ndwadde ya infective endocarditis, okufuuka Memba wa Royal College of Physicians mu 1925, n'ekifo ky'omuyambi omukulu ow'omu ddwaliro eri Sir Thomas Horder, omusawo w'olubiri lw'obwakabaka. Empisa ey'okubuuza kiki ekiri obubi ddala wansi w'obulwadde obulabika kungulu yali egenda kumugoberera okutuuka mu kifo eky'okubuulira.

Wakati mu myaka gy'amakumi abiri, mu kiseera nga eky'emyaka ebiri, okuzuula endwadde ne kukyukira ku eyali azuula. Yakakasibwa nti ekizibu ekisingayo obuziba mu bantu be yajjanjaba tekyali kya busawo wabula kya mwoyo — nti asobola okuweereza omuntu eka ng'amujjanjabye naye n'agenda eka nga akyabuze, nti endwadde entuufu kye kibi, era nti yali ajjanjaba buli kimu okuggyako ekyo ekyali kitta abantu. Mu 1927 yaleka obusawo n'agenda mu buweereza, n'awasa Bethan Phillips (naye yennyini nga musawo asaanyizibwa), era bombi ne bava ku lugendo lwabwe olw'obugole ne bagenda butereevu mu kizimbe eky'okubuulira mu South Wales.

Okuva mu 1927 okutuuka mu 1938 yalunda Bethlehem Forward Movement Mission Church e Sandfields, Aberavon, mu bakozi ab'amakolero, ku mpeera ya nga pawundi 220 buli mwaka. Mu bantu abaabulijjo eddiini ey'ekitiibwa gye yali emaze okugaana — abakozi b'oku mwalo, abanywi, amaka agaali gasaanuse — obulamu bwakyusibwa mu ngeri erabika era etalikoma. Teyakola bino ng'ebisaawe wadde okubyeyunga; yabuulira mu bwangu era ng'anoonya, n'aleka ebivaamu eri Katonda, era kyakakasa kye yali akkirizza: nti enjiri etuuka ku ndwadde obusawo n'enkulaakulana ey'omu bantu gye zitasobola kukwatako.

q: Kiki kye yakola mu Westminster Chapel?
a: Mu 1938 yayitibwa mu Westminster Chapel mu London, okusooka wamu ne G. Campbell Morgan, n'afuuka omuweereza yekka mu 1943, era n'akwata ekifo ky'okubuulira ekyo okutuusa mu 1968. Okumala emyaka amakumi asatu, buli wiiki, yakola ekintu kimu ekitaali kya ngeri ya kiseera: yabuulira ng'ayita mu bitabo bya Baibuli kimu ku kimu, olunyiriri ku lunyiriri, oluusi ng'amala emyaka mingi ku bbaluwa emu. Enfulumira z'ebyokubuulira ennene zaafuuka bijjukizo — okunnyonnyola Abaruumi okw'emyaka mingi, olugendo oluwanvu mu Abaefeso, Studies in the Sermon on the Mount, n'ebyokubuulira ebyakuŋŋaanyizibwa nga Spiritual Depression.

Yateeka okutegeera kwe kwonna mu bikutu ebyafulumizibwa nga Preaching and Preachers, ng'annyonnyola okubuulira nga "logic on fire" (endowooza ey'amagezi eyaka omuliro) era nga "teoloji eyita mu muntu ali mu muliro" — teoloji etaayaka muliro gy'ali yali teoloji nkyamu. Yali ayaayaanira ekyo kye yayita unction, okufukibwako kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ku bigambo by'omuntu, ekyo bwe kitabeerawo okubuulira kubeera kya kusomesa kwokka, era yali tesiga bya kwerakiza wadde obumanyirivu obw'okwogera obutalina buzito bwa mwoyo.

q: Yayigiriza ki ku birowoozo ne ku kwennyamira okw'omwoyo?
a: Okutu kw'omusawo kweyoleka bulungi mu magezi ge agasinga okumanyibwa: "Wategedde nti obutasanyufu bwo obusinga mu bulamu buva ku nsonga nti owuliriza wekka mu kifo ky'okwogera weka?" Ekitabo kye Spiritual Depression: Its Causes and Cure kyafuula okuzuula endwadde okubeera eddagala eriwonya — nga kiyigiriza omukkiriza eyennyamidde okubuulira omutima gwe gwennyini amazima mu kifo ky'okumira obumiizi enneewulira zaagwo, ekyo kyennyini kye yali aggye ku kitanda ky'omulwadde n'akitwala ku kifo eky'okubuulira.

q: Okutakkiriziganya kwe ne John Stott kwali kutya?
a: Nga 18 October 1966, mu National Assembly of Evangelicals, Lloyd-Jones yakoowoola ab'evangelical baleke amadiini ag'enjigiriza "agatabuddwatabuddwa" ne bakuŋŋaana wamu mu bumu obw'evangelical obulabika; John Stott, eyali akulira olukuŋŋaana, yakozesa obukulembeze bwe okuwakanya, ng'akubiriza ab'evangelical Abangalikaani okusigala mu Church of England. Empaka zino zaggulawo enjawukana etaggwaawo mu buvangelical bw'e Britain. Bombi baali batya Katonda era bombi baakkiriza nti baali beesigwa, bombi kyabaviirako, era okunnyogoga kw'omukwano gwabwe kimu ku nnaku ez'amazima ez'olugero luno.

Yabuulira ekyokubuulira kye eky'enkomerero mu 1980, n'aggwaamu amaanyi mu myezi gye egy'enkomerero kookolo bwe yeeyongera. Nga munafu nnyo okwogera bingi, yawandiikira ab'omu maka ge akawaayiro: "Temusabira ku kuwonyezebwa. Temunziyiza kutuuka ku kitiibwa." Kyali ekisalwa ekinywevu eky'omusajja eyamala obuvubuka bwe ng'ayiga okuwanjaba okufa n'obusajja bwe ng'ayiga ekyo okufa kye kutayinza kukwatako. Yafiira mu mirembe nga yeebase nga 1 March 1981, ku lunaku lwa St David, era n'aziikibwa mu nsi ey'ebugwanjuba bwa Wales gye yava.

Yaleka ekibinja kinene eky'ebyokubuulira ebinnyonnyola ebikyasomebwa era nga bikyawulirwa, obuzito obwazzibwawo obw'okubuulira Baibuli, n'ekijjukizo ky'omusajja eyaleka omu ku mirimu egy'ekitiibwa ennyo mu Britain kubanga yali amaze okusalawo ekyali kibi ddala ku bantu. "The Doctor," bwe batyo bonna bwe baamuyita ebbanga ddene oluvannyuma lw'okulekera awo okukola obusawo, era erinnya lyeeyongera okwogera amazima: yali akyusizza abalwadde be era n'akyusa n'endwadde gye yali ajjanjaba, era teyalekeraawo kutwala byafaayo bya bulwadde okutuusa ekizibu ekituufu lwe kyavaayo. Yakkiriza nti ekizibu ekisinga obuziba mu buli omu ku ffe kiyinza okuwonyezebwa, era n'awaayo buli kye yalina okukyogera.
